description: "The Logic of Hegel" by Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel is a philosophical treatise written in the early 19th century. This work serves as a translation and explication of Hegel's "Encyclopaedia of the Philosophical Sciences," specifically focusing on the section dedicated to logic.
